title: How well does my job pay?

breadcrumb.text: How well does my job pay?

body.text: Have you ever wondered who earns more: a pilot or a doctor?

This interactive allows you to explore the data within the [2014 Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings](http://www.ons.gov.uk/ons/rel/ashe/annual-survey-of-hours-and-earnings/2014-provisional-results/stb-ashe-statistical-bulletin-2014.html) release. It illustrates the occupations with the highest and lowest earnings, allows you to compare occupations with similar salaries and even tests your knowledge via a couple of quizzes.
